_about: Copy to config/skills.json in your event-hog-kit repo. get_config serves this file to every connector user: settings only, never credentials. People are keyed by the address their CRM knows them by (crm_email in PEOPLE, else email).

research_tools.name: builtin
research_tools.how: the chat app's own web search and browsing

company_voice.tone: <How the company sounds, in one or two sentences>
dont: Claims about customers or deployments that aren't public

discretion: Public sessions and published material are fair game, with attribution
Hallway and booth conversations are private unless the note says shareable
Never name a prospect or say we met them without their OK
Nothing is posted from event-hog: drafts only, a person posts

image_host.what: Cloudflare R2 bucket on this deployment's account, served by the event-hog Worker at /media/<key>
image_host.how: Automatic: the capture page uploads there and writes image_url into the slide's notes. Nothing for the agent to do.
